v1.0.1 Changelog

- Added a command-line interface (`scripts/cli.mjs`) to standardize API calls and upstream error handling for both meme-rush and topic-rush subcommands.
- Introduced a dedicated CLI reference document (`references/cli.md`) with detailed API usage, parameters, and field semantics.
- Expanded supported chains to include Base (`8453`) for the meme-rush feed.
- Skill description, usage guidance, and supported protocols/chains refactored for clarity and conciseness.
- Removed obsolete documentation file (`skill-card.md`).

Initial release of Meme Rush — a fast-trading assistant for meme tokens.

- Provides real-time lists of new, finalizing, and migrated meme tokens from major launchpads across BSC and Solana.
- Tracks full token lifecycle, including bonding curve progress and migration to DEX.
- Offers advanced filtering for dev activity, holder analysis, and on-chain trading data.
- Features Topic Rush: AI-powered discovery of hot market narratives, ranking related tokens by net inflow.
- Supports major meme token platforms like Pump.fun, Four.meme, and more.
